summary: Tested ApexBio backend (9 pytest cases) and frontend flows (Home->Result->tabs/whatis-toggle/save/Ask FAB, Explore, Compare, Symptom, Lab). All 9 backend tests passed (analyze mineral/symptom/comparison via cached queries, ask, explore, trending, saved CRUD, validation). All frontend flows work. LLM answers returned correctly. No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: First-time (uncached) calls take ~60-90s; ensured tests use pre-cached queries. Consider adding request timeout/streaming for uncached calls.
POST returns 200 for both new save and duplicate 'exists' response. A 201 for new and 200 for existing would be more RESTful (not blocking).

action_items: Task description mentioned routes '/symptom' and '/lab' but actual routes are '/symptoms' and '/labs'. Not a bug, just a documentation mismatch in the test spec.

Task description mentioned tab id 'tab-food-sources', 'tab-safety', 'tab-mechanism' - these work. Also mentioned 'tab-what-is-it' which does NOT exist; What-Is-It lives inside the Overview tab (tab-overview) with a beginner/advanced toggle (whatis-beginner/whatis-advanced) which does work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: analytics upsert uses raw subject as a Mongo field name; a subject with a '.' would break Mongo dot-notation. Sanitize keys.
server.py: /api/saved uses `subject` in URL path for delete; special characters would need URL encoding (frontend already encodes).
server.py: extract_json swallows secondary JSONDecodeError; if the primary decode fails the raw response is written to /tmp/last_raw.txt only in analyze() – good, but log location is ephemeral.
server.py: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is optional-fetched; if unset, LlmChat will fail with a confusing 502. Consider validating at startup.
Frontend: /result page relies on axios timeout of 180s; if user navigates away during a cold analyze call, response is orphaned (acceptable for MVP).
seed_data_creation: None; used Mongo cached queries (Magnesium/tired/Creatine vs Beta-Alanine).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes are under /api. Actual frontend routes: /symptoms and /labs (not /symptom or /lab as in some docs). Tab data-testids: tab-overview, tab-mechanism, tab-benefits, tab-deficiency, tab-food-sources, tab-supplementation, tab-safety, tab-interactions, tab-performance, tab-biomarkers, tab-myths, tab-research. WhatIsIt toggle is inside Overview tab (whatis-beginner, whatis-advanced). Cached LLM queries: 'Teach me everything about Magnesium', 'Why am I always tired?', 'Creatine vs beta-alanine' - use these for fast tests.
